name: aobplatform
description: AoBPlatform monorepo root. Read CLAUDE.md and CONVENTIONS.md before adding anything here.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/domain && npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run build -w packages/vault-client && npm run build -w packages/auth-client
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w apps/connector -w apps/core -w apps/rules -w apps/vault -w apps/web --if-present
